answer.book: Goldast, Collectio Constitutionum Imperialium, vol. 2 (1673): a collection of imperial constitutions, capitularies and related documents from the Frankish kings to the Staufen emperors, with a dedication to Emperor Matthias, lists of Reichsstände, an elenchus of tractates and commentary by Goldast and Freher; the Libri Carolini are printed in four books, each a numbered sequence of capitula.
